Name: Bentleys Fast Food Useful Stuff
Author: BentleyTheModder1
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff9933]Bentley Playz[/color] Fast Food & Useful Stuff[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A new restaurant, new characters, new food, and plenty of questionable decisions![/b][/size][/center]

Welcome to Bentley's Fast Food & Useful Stuff! This mod adds a fully walk-in restaurant to Stardew Valley, complete with its own interior, ordering counter, dining booths, dessert corner, arcade, and even Bentley's bedroom.

The restaurant is located on the Bus Stop lawn, with an open, welcoming entrance and its own dirt path leading toward the road.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]New Characters[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Bentley[/b]

Meet Bentley, the owner of the restaurant and a new villager in Stardew Valley!

- Birthday: Spring 12
- Has custom sprites and portraits.
- Has a winter outfit.
- Wears a hazmat suit during the Green Rain.
- Is not romanceable.
- Has his own daily schedule.
- Visits Gus's Stardrop Saloon in the evening.

[b]Restaurant Robot[/b]

Meet the Restaurant Robot, another new character who helps keep the restaurant running!

- Has custom dialogue and a portrait.
- Greets customers at the restaurant.
- Helps cover the ordering counter in the evening.
- Cannot receive gifts.
- Does not have a friendship heart system.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Restaurant Features[/color][/b][/size]

- A fully walk-in restaurant.
- A dedicated ordering counter.
- Dining booths and chairs that can be sat on.
- A dessert corner with its own selection of treats.
- An arcade room featuring vanilla Prairie King and Junimo Kart.
- Bentley's bedroom behind the kitchen staff door.
- Restaurant lighting and interior decorations.
- A welcoming exterior entrance with an open fence area.
- A dedicated dirt path leading toward the road.
- A welcome letter delivered when you begin.
- Update announcements when the mod is updated.

The restaurant is open 24 hours. The entrance and ordering counter never close.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Food Menu[/color][/b][/size]

Cheeseburger| 180g

Chicken Nuggets are exclusive to Bentley's restaurant counter.

[b]Gus's Stardrop Saloon[/b]

Bentley's food additions are also available at Gus's Saloon, without removing Gus's existing stock.

- Cheeseburger — 180g
- French Fries — 90g
- Coke — 100g
- Windex — 25g
- Farmhand Snack Pack — 220g

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Dessert Corner[/color][/b][/size]

The restaurant also includes a dessert kiosk with several sweet treats!

Dessert| Price
Ice Cream Sundae| 200g
Soft Serve Cone| 140g
Fudge Brownie| 160g
Strawberry Cheesecake| 220g
Glazed Donut| 120g
Banana Split| 260g
Windex Swirl Cone| 60g

Some desserts provide small buffs:

- Soft Serve Cone: Speed +1
- Strawberry Cheesecake: Defense +1
- Banana Split: Luck +1

Milkshakes are cooked rather than sold. Bentley teaches the Milkshake recipe when you reach 4 hearts with him.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Windex Warning[/color][/b][/size]

Windex is a fictional joke item included in this mod. It is not real glass cleaner.

Drinking the in-game Windex or eating the Windex Swirl Cone causes health damage by default. The damage will never reduce your health below 1.

You can adjust or disable the damage through the mod configuration:

- WindexDrinkDamage
- WindexSwirlConeDamage

Set either value to 0 to disable its corresponding damage.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Character Schedules[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Bentley[/b]

Bentley follows the same schedule in Spring, including rainy days:

- 6:10 AM — Restaurant ordering counter, tile (16, 4).
- 6:00 PM — Gus's Stardrop Saloon, tile (24, 17).
- 9:00 PM — Goes home and sleeps in his bedroom, tile (10, 5).

[b]Restaurant Robot[/b]

The Restaurant Robot also follows the same schedule in Spring, including rainy days:

- 6:00 AM — Bentley's bedroom, tile (2, 9).
- 6:00 PM — Restaurant ordering counter, tile (15, 4).
- Remains at the restaurant counter until the day ends.

The Robot takes over counter coverage at 6:00 PM, while Bentley handles the counter during the daytime.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Arcade Room[/color][/b][/size]

The restaurant includes an arcade room with two familiar vanilla games:

- Prairie King
- Junimo Kart

Both arcade machines are included in the restaurant interior.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]How the Mod Works[/color][/b][/size]

This mod uses two main components:

- [b]Content Patcher:[/b] Handles custom content, maps, and game assets.
- [b]Custom SMAPI DLL:[/b] Provides additional code-based features and functionality.

Both components are included as part of the combined mod installation.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Requirements:[/b]

- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later within the 1.6 series (other versions have not been tested).
- SMAPI 4.1.10 or later.
- Content Patcher 2.6.0 or later.

[b]Compatibility Notes:[/b]

- The restaurant has support for the Bus Stop map.
- The restaurant also appears in the Ice Festival version of the Bus Stop.
- Compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded has not been tested.
- Other mods that modify the Bus Stop may conflict.
- Festival support can be enabled through the EnableFestivals configuration option. This feature is experimental and disabled by default.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

1. Make sure SMAPI and Content Patcher are installed.
2. Remove older versions of the following folders from your Mods directory:
- BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff
- BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff_SMAPI
3. Extract the combined mod folder, [b]BentleyPlayz FastFoodUsefulStuff[/b], directly into your Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley and check the SMAPI console for errors.

[b]Important upgrade notes:[/b]

- Save outside the restaurant before updating because the interior layout may change.
- The old Farm building from versions before 3.0.0 should be demolished.
- Older furniture items may appear as error items because the furniture shop was removed in version 3.13.0.
- Existing Bus Stop bushes, weeds, and twigs may remain after installation.

Your save files remain compatible with the updated mod.
